archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: Bug is manifest/consumer/doc drift; verify the manifest, its two consumers, and the docs stay consistent after the edits
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the run-log completeness contract stays internally consistent after this change. Confirm that removing the version-bump-reasoning.md row from docs/run-logs-required-files.tsv does not break step8 condition detection in python/larch/issue/audit_runs.py (cond step8) or python/larch/report/run_logs.py (_verify_condition_reached step8), since final-summary.md still covers step8. Confirm the new _publish_plan_review_tally stub in python/larch/state/bootstrap.py writes a valid json-object that satisfies the plan-review-tally.json always required-file row and survives the json-object sanitizer and redaction in run-log write. Check that docs/run-logs.md matches the new behavior and flag any other doc, test, or consumer that still expects the removed file or the previously always-missing tally. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
